title: Persisted profile
description: Shape of <project>/.sendbird-client/profile.json — every field detection-result.schema.json produces, plus appId and any field a customer or skill has chosen and stored. Deliberately open (additionalProperties: true): a stored field detect.sh doesn't itself produce must survive re-detection, not be rejected — see tools/detection/detect.sh's merge and core/README.md.

legacyMajors.description: Sendbird SDKs on an older major version, as detection-result.schema.json describes. Optional: profiles written before this field existed do not have it.

appId.description: Not a secret — persisted so the customer is asked for it only once per project. Session/access tokens are never persisted.
